title: Artroskopi forbruksmateriell til helseforetakene i Helse Nord
description: Anskaffelsen tar sikte på å opprette avtaler for artroskopi forbruksmateriell for helseforetakene tilknyttet Helse Nord.

title: Brannalarm- nød- og ledelyssystemer (vedlikehold)
description: Rammeavtalen skal dekke brannalarmanlegg (omfatter alarmorganisering) og nødlys og ledesystemer i forbindelse med akutte utbedringsarbeider, planlagte vedlikeholdsarbeider og mindre rehabiliteringsprosjekter. Eiendommer kan bli lagt til eller tatt ut av rammeavtalen i løpet av kontraktsperioden, og årsaken til dette kan for eksempel være nybygg, rehabilitering og rivning. Nye anlegg som kommer inn i rammeavtalen skal ha samme betingelser. Rammeavtaleleverandørene vil bli tildelt en fast portefølje. Dog kan dette avvikes ved endrede behov for både Oppdragsgiver og leverandør.

title: Internkontroll og drift/vedlikehold elektro - RK2026
description: Formålet med anskaffelsen er å etablere to rammeavtaler som skal sikre god og dokumenterbar internkontroll EL, og dekke kommunens supplerende behov for elektrotjenester inkl. materiell utover bruk av egen arbeidskraft. Vi skal ha ulike leverandører på disse to tjenesteområdene.Avtalen skal sikre stabilitet og kvalitet i tjenesteytingen gjennom å øke kapasiteten og kompetansen på denne type tjenester. Kommunen søker derfor avtaleparter som er effektive og kompetente, med positive samarbeidsegenskaper.Leverandøren skal sikre kommunens dokumentasjon via digital loggføring. Kommunen bruker Facilit FDVU. Avrop på tjenester, materiell til forvaltning, drift og vedlikehold av eiendom, bygg og anlegg skjer ved bruk av denne elektroniske løsningen.Kontraktens varighet er 2 år med rett til forlengelse i 1+1 år. Konkurransens verdi anslås til henholdsvis kr 14 millioner for delkontrakt 1, drift og vedlikehold, med en maksimal verdi på kr 15,1 millioner. Og kr 1,8 millioner, med en maksimal verdi på kr 2,3 millioner over fire år for delkontrakt 2, internkontroll. Behovet vil kunne bli større eller mindre i kontraktsperioden, f.eks. som følge av at kommunen erverver nye eller avhender bygninger. For det tilfelle at innkjøpet defineres som prosjekt, står kommunen fritt til å be om tilbud hos flere leverandører. Dette vil gjelde både sterk- og svakstrøms-installasjoner. Fullstendig beskrivelse av leveransen følger av kontraktsutkastene til hver av de to delkontraktene.

title: Leasingbiler Kautokeino kommune
description: Oppdragsgiver i denne anskaffelsen er Kautokeino kommune k.nr: 5612Oppdragsgiver skal anskaffe leasing av tjenestebiler til bruk for flere kommunale avdelinger. Anskaffelsen omfatter kjøretøy som skal dekke et bredt spekter av tjenestebehov, blant annet innen helse- og omsorgstjenester, psykisk helse, bo‑ og oppfølgingstjenester samt drift og eiendom.Formålet med anskaffelsen er å sikre tilgang til pålitelige, funksjonelle og kostnadseffektive kjøretøy som er godt tilpasset kommunal tjenesteproduksjon, lokale kjøreforhold og bruksmønster. Kjøretøyene skal bidra til effektiv tjenesteutførelse samtidig som det legges vekt på komfort, sikkerhet, universell bruk og lave driftskostnader.For å oppnå en hensiktsmessig og oversiktlig anskaffelse er bilbehovet strukturert i et begrenset antall kjøretøysegmenter basert på størrelse, bruksområde og funksjon.Leverandører står fritt til å gi tilbud på én, flere eller samtlige delkontrakter.

title: Logging table system
description: The Geological survey of Norway is procuring a logging table system for its drill core archive at Løkken, Trøndelag. The Løkken Drill Core Archive serves as a national archive for geological sample material from Norway, with a primary focus on drill cores, and is used by exploration companies and other stakeholders in the mineral industry.

title: C06756 - Lagerhall HVLOG - Værnes - Prosjekt 101404
description: Det skal bygges en lagerhall på 1170m2, en utendørs lagerflate for containere. Tillegg til hall skal det bygges areal for tekniske rom og arbeidsplasser. Veier og manøverområder på ca 2000 m2 skal opparbeides.

title: Servicebygg Kinn
description: Kinn kommune vil med denne anskaffinga inngå avtale med en totalentreprenør for å rive eksisterende bygg og oppføring av nytt servicebygg på øya Kinn. Prosjektet omfatter etablering av et nytt, funksjonelt og robust servicebygg tilpasset stedets særegne beliggenhet, klima og bruk. Tiltaket inkluderer full riving og miljøsanering av eksisterende bygningsmasse, samt prosjektering og oppføring av nytt bygg med tilhørende tekniske installasjoner og utomhusarbeider. Det vil bli lagt vekt på løsninger med god kvalitet, lavt vedlikeholdsbehov og hensyn til kulturmiljø og landskap. Logistikk og gjennomføringsevne vil være særlig viktig gitt øyas lokasjon og begrensede tilkomst. Se konkurransegrunnlag med vedlegg for ytterligere informasjon om konkurransen

title: Leirskoleopphold for Tingvoll kommune
description: Bakgrunn Tingvoll kommune skal inngå en ny avtale om bemannet leirskoleopphold for elever i grunnskolen. Leirskole er en fast del av opplæringen, og kommunen har behov for en forutsigbar løsning som kan gjennomføres årlig med god kvalitet, trygghet og praktisk gjennomførbarhet. Formålet med anskaffelsen er å sikre et helhetlig leirskoleopphold som gir elevene læring, sosial mestring og felles opplevelser innenfor trygge rammer. Kommunen ønsker en leverandør som kan tilby et godt organisert opplegg med relevant pedagogisk innhold, hensiktsmessig tilrettelegging og profesjonell ivaretakelse av sikkerhet og beredskap. Anskaffelsen gjennomføres fordi tidligere avtale er utløpt. Det er behov for en ny løsning som gir stabilitet over tid og som kan håndtere mindre variasjoner i tidspunkt og deltakerantall fra år til år. For leverandørene er det viktig å merke seg at oppholdet skal være praktisk gjennomførbart for kommunen, blant annet med en hensiktsmessig reiseavstand fra Tingvoll. Beskrivelse av oppdraget Anskaffelsen gjelder bemannet leirskoleopphold for Tingvoll kommune. Oppdraget omfatter et årlig opphold med 3 overnattinger for én elevgruppe, normalt elever på 7. trinn om våren eller 8. trinn om høsten. Omfanget er i utgangspunktet om lag 40 elever per år samt minimum 5 medfølgende voksne. Leveransen skal være en samlet tjeneste som omfatter overnatting, måltider, bemannede aktiviteter, praktisk tilrettelegging og vertskapsfunksjon under oppholdet. Kommunen etterspør et strukturert og trygt opplegg med aktiviteter og innhold tilpasset skolegruppe. Leveransen skal legge til rette for læring, samarbeid og sosial utvikling, samtidig som oppholdet skal være godt organisert og enkelt å planlegge og gjennomføre for skolen. Oppdraget forutsetter at leverandøren kan tilby egnede fasiliteter og et opplegg som ivaretar sentrale hensyn knyttet til sikkerhet, beredskap og nødvendig tilrettelegging. Leirskolestedet skal ligge innenfor en praktisk reiseavstand fra Tingvoll sentrum.

title: Steinsvika-Brekka - Ny hovedvannforsyning - Skien kommune
description: Skien kommune inviterer til konkurranse om Entreprise Kumgruppe 1 i prosjektet Steinsvika – Brekka – Ny hovedvannforsyning, Fase 1 øst. Entreprisens (omtrentlige) avgrensning er vist på tegning H201. Prosjektet omfatter kryssing av Ulefossvegen med ny VA-trase, reetablering av veg ifm. kryssingen og etablering av kumgruppe 1. Det skal etableres plasstøpt vannkum med overbygg for hovedvannledning, prefabrikert pumpestasjon med overbygg, samt vann-, spillvann- og overvannskummer. Det skal også legges rør for fiber, jordingsledning og kabel for strømforsyning (inkl. nødvendige installasjoner) til: - Vannmåler i kum VK1a - Prefabrikkert pumpestasjon PST1 - Nivåføler for overløpsmåling i kum SK1a - Nivåføler i buffertank SK1b For nærmere orientering om prosjektet, entrepriseoppdeling og kontraktarbeidet, se del II - Kontraktsgrunnlaget. Kontraktens oppstart er satt til 4. januar 2027.

Anskaffelsen skal erstatte eksisterende avtale som utløper ved årsskiftet 2026/2027. Vi ønsker et verktøy som ivaretar sikkerhet, søkbarhet og arbeidsflyt på en brukervennlig måte.

title: Rammeavtale for elektrotjenester for Sør-Aurdal kommune
description: Sør-Aurdal kommune inviterer til åpen tilbudskonkurranse om rammeavtale for elektrotjenester. Anskaffelsen omfatter levering av elektrotjenester og tilhørende materiell i forbindelse med drift, vedlikehold, reparasjoner, feilsøking og mindre prosjekter på kommunens bygningsportefølje, kommunale boliger, vann- og avløpsanlegg (VA), vannverk, renseanlegg, tekniske installasjoner og øvrige kommunale anlegg. Oppdragsgiver har til hensikt å inngå rammeavtale med inntil tre leverandører. Leverandørene vil bli rangert basert på resultatet av konkurransen. Oppdrag tildeles i utgangspunktet rangert leverandør nr. 1, men ved manglende kapasitet kan oppdrag tildeles øvrige rammeavtaleleverandører. For større og mer komplekse oppdrag kan det gjennomføres minikonkurranser mellom rammeavtaleleverandørene. Avtalens varighet er 2 år med opsjon på forlengelse 1 + 1 år. Tildelingskriterier: • Pris 50 % • Miljø 30 % • Kvalitet 20 % Nærmere beskrivelse av anskaffelsen fremgår av konkurransegrunnlaget med vedlegg.

description: Forsvarsbygg inviterer leverandøren til å inngi tilbud på følgende arbeider: Utskifting av eksisterende tak på bygg i Stranddalsveien 3, Bjerkvik i Narvik kommune, inkludert nødvendig tilhørende arbeider for komplett og ferdigstilt leveranse. title: Ny sjukeheim Bråvolltunet
description: Oppdragsgiver, Ullensvang kommune, innbyr til konkurranse om kontrakt i prosjektet ny sjukeheim Bråvolltunet. Bråvolltunet sjukeheim ligg i Kinsarvik i Ullensvang Kommune, og vart bygd i 1987. I dette prosjektet skal det byggast eit tilbygg over 3 plan som skal romma 18 nye sjukeheimsplassar, garderobar, minnerom og lager. Deler av eksisterande sjukeheim skal byggast om med ny skjerma avdeling med 6 plassar. I tillegg vil det i underetasjen verta etablert nye fasilitetar for mellom anna heimeteneste og fysioterapi. For nærare orientering om prosjektet, entrepriseoppdeling og kontraktarbeidet, se del II - Kontraktsgrunnlaget. Kontraktens oppstart er satt til 30.11.2026, med forventet ferdigstilling 30.11.2029. ( prosjekteringsfase 4mnd, oppstart tilbygg april -27, estimert byggetid tilbygg 18 mnd + rehabilitering 12 mnd + 2 mnd slakk = 36 mnd) Som del av prosjektet inngår også flaumsikringstiltak og VA-arbeider. Det er viktig å merka seg, at denne delen av prosjektet er detaljprosjektert, og skal handterast som ein utførelsesentreprise. For denne delen av kontrakten, kan arbeider på byggeplass startast på så snart naudsynte løyver er på plass, og vertilhøve for årstida tillet det, tentativt januar 2027. Som kontraktsbestemmelser gjelder NS 8407 med de korreksjoner som fremgår av del II -Kontraktsgrunnlaget, punkt B.2 Spesielle kontraktsbestemmelser og B.3 Seriøsitetskrav.

title: Oppussing av kommunehuset i Sogndal - ventilasjonssystem
description: Bakgrunn og formål Sogndal kommune skal pusse opp Kommunehuset ettersom bygget treng oppgradert ventilasjonsanlegg og overflateopppussing. Nokre vegger skal rivast for å laga større kontor. Det vil bli nokre nye vegger, bl.a i 2. etasje der det vert eit nytt møterom. Elles vert rominndeling tilnærma slik den er i dag. Det skal monterast himling i alle kontor, møterom og kommunestyresalen. Status og målsetting Tiltak skal prosjekterast og utførast som sidestilt totalentreprise i henhold til NS 8407. Delkontraktar Det utlyste prosjektet er delt i fire ulike delkontrakter: tømrararbeid, el-arbeid, malar/golvlegging og ventilasjon. I tillegg er det noko mindre og spesialisert arbeid som vert teken i tillegg. Oppdragsgjevar vil koordinere faga. Oppdragsgjevar tek atterhald om å kunne avlyse konkurransen dersom den totale summen på delkontraktene vert høgare enn budsjettert verdi.

title: Rammeavtale for kjøp av digitalt felles brukerutstyr/AV-utstyr og tilhørende tjenester
description: Formålet med anskaffelsen er å inngå rammeavtale for kjøp av «digitalt felles brukerutstyr/AV-utstyr og tilhørende tjenester». Avtalen vil dekke behov for digitalt felles brukerutstyr (DFB) for alle virksomheter og bygg hvor Bærum kommune er ansvarlig for slikt fellesutstyr. Kommunen har egne avtaler for klientutstyr.

title: Utskifting ventilasjon og varme ved Grane barne - og ungdomsskole Vegset
description: Regionalt innkjøpssamarbeid (RIH) inviterer på vegne av Grane kommune til åpen anbudskonkurranse for utskifting av ventilasjon og oppvarming ved Grane barne- og ungdomsskole (GBU) Vegset.Oppdraget gjennomføres som en totalentreprise iht NS 8407.Anbudsbefaring gjennomføres på GBU Vegset torsdag 24. september 2026. kl 08:30.Påmelding til anbudsbefaring skjer på e-post til: hakon.husby@grane.kommune.no

title: Finland – Works for complete or part construction and civil engineering work – Osallistumispyyntö: Vt 9 Tampere-Orivesi 1.vaihe, STk
description: Urakka on kokonaishintaperusteinen kehitysvaiheen sisältävä Suunnittele ja toteuta -urakka (STk). Tavanomaiseen ST-urakkaan lisäyksenä on urakoitsijan valinnan ja rakentamisen välille sijoittuva tilaajan ja urakoitsijan yhteinen kehitysvaihe, jossa mm. on tavoitteena kehittää suunnitelmaratkaisuja. Kehitysvaihe on kuvattu tarkemmin tarjouspyyntöasiakirjoissa. Tarjoukseen ei edellytä liitettäväksi alustavaa rakennussuunnitelmaa. Kuitenkin urakoitsija vastaa tarjousratkaisujensa tuotevaatimusten mukaisuudesta. Kehitysvaiheessa tilaaja ja urakoitsija jatkavat rakentamissuunnitelman kehittämistä yhteistyössä urakoitsijan kanssa. Kehitysvaihe päättyy, kun tilaaja tekee päätöksen toteutusvaiheeseen siirtymisestä. Urakka sisältää noin neljän kuukauden kehitysvaiheen, jonka jälkeen päätetään toteutusvaiheesta. Kehitysvaiheen tilaaja maksaa urakoitsijalle vastineeksi kehitysvaiheen urakkasopimuksen mukaisten tehtävien ja suorittamisesta yksikköhintaperusteisesti toteutuneiden työtuntien ja kulujen mukaisesti. Urakka sisältää ennen lopullisen rakentamissuunnitelman laatimista ja rakennustöiden aloitusta noin kolmesta neljään kuukauden mittaisen kehitys-vaiheen. Kehitysvaiheessa urakoitsijalla ja tilaajalla on yhdessä mahdollisuus: - kehittää toteutusratkaisuja tiesuunnitelman ja tiesuunnitelman muutossuunnitelman ja tuotevaatimusten puitteissa - kehittää tiesuunnitelmaratkaisuja teknis-taloudellisesti paremmiksi, huomioiden kuitenkin tiesuunnitelmamuutosten hallinnolliseen prosessiin liittyvät mahdollisuudet ja riskit - kehittää urakan tuotevaatimuksia teknis-taloudellisesti paremmat ratkaisut mahdollistaviksi - kehittää urakan toteutukseen liittyviä toimintatapoja sekä tilaajan ja urakoitsijan välisiä yhteistyömenettelyitä - valmistella rakennustöiden aloittaminen ja siihen liittyvät suunnitelmat sekä muut asiakirjat Tilaaja päättää urakoitsijan esittämien muutosten hyväksymisestä ja vastaa muutosten edellyttämästä sopimusasiakirjojen muuttamisesta. Kehitysvaiheen tuloksena syntyy tilaajan hyväksymä teknis-taloudellisesti optimoitu alustava rakentamissuunnitelma sekä ensimmäisten työvaiheiden aloitusedellytyksenä olevat muut asiakirjat. Tilaaja laatii yksipuolisella päätöksellä päätöksen toteutusvaiheeseen siirtymisestä, johon kirjataan kehitysvaiheessa sovittujen muutosten mukaisesti tarkennettu urakkahinta, joka korvaa sopimuksentekohetkellä sovitun urakkahinnan. Urakkaan kuuluu ”Vt 9 Tampere-Orivesi 1.vaihe, STk" rakentamissuunnittelu ja rakentaminen siinä laajuudessa kuin se suunnitelma-asiakirjoissa on määritelty kaikkine tiejärjestelyineen, varusteineen ja laitteineen siinä laajuudessa kuin tarjouspyynnön liitteenä olevissa asiakirjoissa on määritelty. Urakkaan kuuluu töiden osalta rakentamisen toteuttaminen sopimusasiakirjojen vaatimukset täyttäen siten, että se myös tekniseltä toimivuudeltaan vastaa sille sopimusasiakirjoissa asetettuja vaatimuksia. Urakkaan kuuluu töiden osalta suunnittelun ja rakentamisen toteuttaminen sopimusasiakirjojen vaatimukset täyttäen siten, että se myös tekniseltä toimivuudeltaan vastaa sille sopimusasiakirjoissa asetettuja vaatimuksia Urakkaan kuuluu myös tiedotus-, raportointi- sekä takuuaikaisia hoito- ja raportointitöitä ja päätoteuttajan rooliin kuuluvia yhteensovittamisvelvoitteita tarjouspyyntöasiakirjojen mukaisesti. Urakkaan kuuluu työt siinä laajuudessa, kuin ne on tarjouspyynnön liitteenä olevissa asiakirjoissa määritelty kaikkine tiejärjestelyineen, varusteineen ja laitteineen. Urakoitsijan tulee suorittaa kaikki ne työt ja niihin liittyvät hankinnat, jotka asiakirjojen mukaisen työsuorituksen valmiiksi saattaminen edellyttää ja joista ei nimenomaan asiakirjoissa mainita, etteivät ne kuulu urakoitsijan suoritusvelvollisuuteen. Urakan sisältö on määritetty tarkemmin tarjouspyyntöasiakirjoissa.

title: France – Consultative engineering and construction services – Mission de maîtrise d’œuvre spécialisée pour la conception et le suivi d’exécution des ouvrages de captage et de rejet d’eau sur la Garonne Toulouse
description: La présente consultation s'inscrit dans le cadre de la Délégation de Service Public (DSP) relative au réseau de chaleur et de froid urbain « Plaine Campus », concédée par Toulouse Métropole à la société Toulouse Énergie Durable (TED). Afin de répondre aux enjeux de transition énergétique et de sécurisation de l'approvisionnement, l'avenant n°7 au contrat de DSP prévoit une extension majeure du réseau et une densification des moyens de production via des énergies renouvelables. L'opération consiste en la création d'un outil de production de chaleur innovant utilisant l'énergie de la Garonne. Ce projet vise à augmenter le taux d'EnRR du réseau à plus de 85%. Le projet consiste en la réhabilitation et la transformation d'un bâtiment existant emblématique situé sur l'Île du Ramier en une centrale hydrothermique de 5.5Mc. Ce site, soumis à des contraintes techniques, patrimoniales et environnementales fortes, doit accueillir une cascade de pompes à chaleur (PAC) de haute technologie valorisant l'énergie thermique captée sur la Garonne. Le projet exige un traitement exemplaire. La consultation porte sur une mission de maîtrise d'oeuvre spécialisée dans la conception et le suivi de réalisation d'ouvrages de prise d'eau et de rejet en milieu fluvial. Le titulaire devra assurer l'intégralité des missions de MOE au sens du Code de la commande publique complétées par des exigences de qualité supérieure pour la gestion des interfaces process/bâtiment, l'accessibilité, la maintenance et la performance thermique de la centrale.

title: Ireland – Recruitment services – Provision of Sourcing of Short-term and Temporary Locum General Practitioners (GPs) for the Health Sector in Ireland.
description: The Health Service Executive seeks to appoint suitably qualified employment agencies to source short-term locum General Practitioners (GPs) for General Medical Services (GMS) GPs working in rural Ireland. The purpose of this tender is to support access to locum cover for up to 250 GMS General Practitioners (GPs) in rural and remote areas, who are in receipt of the Rural Practice allowance. GPs in rural and remote areas must be able to access reliable locum cover to allow them take leave knowing that their patients will continue to receive high-quality care in their absence. This scheme, developed under the terms of the 2023 GP Agreement, addresses a critical need for rural GPs who often face significant challenges in securing cover for periods of planned leave. It is envisaged that most leave requests will be for 1 to 2 week leave periods. The maximum leave duration that will be requested is a block of 5 weeks in total. Under this scheme, eligible GPs in receipt of rural practice support will have access to a streamlined locum sourcing service. The service is currently provided by one employment agency under a non-compliant pilot programme set up by the National Contracts Office. This tender process is being conducted as an open-style tender under Annex XIV of Procurement directives 2014/24/EU. The required services are listed as Annex XIV services, and accordingly, only Articles 74 to 77 of Directive 2014/24/EC applies to the award of any contract(s) that arise from this process. As such, there is considerable flexibility in conducting the tender process and this is required given the specialist nature of the services required and the very limited market. Tenderers will be ranked and scored according to the Award Criteria stated. The four top ranked tenderers will be offered a contract. The estimated cost is €100k + VAT per year. The contract is for an initial 36-month period. At the end of this period the HSE can assess if the services being delivered are satisfactory or if the requirements of the scheme changes. There are 2 x 12-month optional extensions. The current focus is ensuring that a contract is in place in early 2027

title: Germany – Engineering design services – Erweiterungsbau und Umbau Grundschule Bernhardswald für Ganztagsbetreuung - Leistungsbild Gebäudeplanung
description: Die Gemeinde Bernhardswald plant einen Erweiterungsbau der Grundschule Bernhardswald für die ganztätige Betreuung der Grundschüler/innen. Im Rahmen einer Machbarkeitsstudie wurden mehrere Standorte für den Anbau untersucht und bewertet. Der beschlossene Vorentwurf für den kooperativen Ganztag in Form eines Anbaus sieht vor, dass der Speisesaal, die Küche sowie ein Garderobenbereich und ein barrierefreies WC an die bereits bestehende Flurzone im Nordosten des Schulhauses angegliedert werden. In diesem Zuge wird auch die bestehende Pausenhalle vergrößert. Da es sich bei dem Schulgebäude um ein Splitt-Level handelt, wird durch das Versetzen eines Treppenpodestes ebenfalls der Einbau eines Aufzuges vorgesehen. Dazu kommt, dass bestehende Räume des Hortes sowie der Mittagsbetreuung im Untergeschoss der Grundschule in das Raumprogramm für den kooperativen Ganztag mitaufgenommen werden. Um die notwendigen Aufenthaltsbereiche für die ganztätige Betreuung sowie das Mittagessen für bis zu 160 Schülerinnen und Schüler zu ermöglichen werden folgende Neu – bzw. Umbauten am bestehenden Schulgebäude vorgesehen: Aufenthaltsbereiche für die ganztätige Betreuung mit z.B. Schmökerinsel, Hausaufgaben- und Musikbereich mit 305 m², einer Versorgungsküche als Aufbereitungsküche inkl. Nebenräume mit 55 m² sowie einem Speisesaal im Zweischichtbetrieb mit 120 m². Zudem wird die bestehende Pausenhalle um 89 m² vergrößert und der Pausenhof ist mit 808 m² nach dem Umbau wieder herzustellen. Die Kosten der Maßnahme werden derzeit auf rund 5,85 Mio. € brutto geschätzt. Dieser Kostenrahmen soll eingehalten werden. Wichtige vorgesehene zeitliche Meilensteine: • Abgabe Förderantrag und Bauantrag im Juni/Juli 2027 • Ausschreibung und Vergabe im September/Oktober 2027 • Beginn Bauausführung März 2028 • Fertigstellung spätestens bis zum Schuljahresbeginn 2030/2031 Vergeben werden die Leistungen Leistungsbild Gebäudeplanung stufenweise. Die Beauftragung erfolgt für die Leistungsphasen 2–9 stufenweise. Zunächst vergeben werden nur die LP. 2 und 3, anschließend optional stufenweise die weiteren Leistungsphasen. Ein Anspruch auf Beauftragung weiterer Leistungsphasen/Stufen besteht nicht. Aus der stufenweisen Beauftragung kann der Bieter keinen Mehrhonoraranspruch ableiten. Der Abruf weiterer Stufen muss schriftlich erfolgen. Während den Ausführungsarbeiten ist der reguläre Schulalltag zu gewährleisten. Ein Augenmerk ist hierbei besonders auf einen sehr gut strukturierten und einzuhaltenden Bauablauf zu legen, um beispielsweise Ferienwochen effizient zu nutzen.

title: Netherlands – Presents and rewards – Representatie artikelen
description: De Opdracht betreft het leveren van representatieartikelen, waaronder (feestdagen)attenties en (digitale) cadeaubonnen, ten behoeve van de Belastingdienst, Douane en Toeslagen. De raamovereenkomst ondersteunt de uitvoering van het personeelsbeleid van de Belastingdienst, waarin erkenning, waardering en betrokkenheid van medewerkers centraal staan. Met deze aanbesteding wordt beoogd een raamovereenkomst te sluiten met de inschrijver die de economisch meest voordelige inschrijving (EMVI) op basis van de beste prijs-kwaliteitverhouding indient. De omvang van de Opdracht is gebaseerd op historische cijfers. De omvang van de Opdracht is voor de duur van de raamovereenkomst, inclusief opties tot verlenging geraamd op: € 8.693.996,- exclusief btw.

title: Gebäudeinnenreinigung von 4 Schulen in Bremen
description: Ziel dieser Ausschreibung ist es, einen geeigneten Auftragnehmer für die Gebäudeinnenreinigung von vier Schulen zu finden. Dies beinhaltet die fachgerechte Gebäudeinnenreinigung der im Raumbuch jeweils enthaltenen Raumgruppen sowie dieerforderlichen Maßnahmen zur Pflege und Werterhaltung. Außerdem wird die Bereitschaft für zusätzliche Sonderreinigungen und -leistungen nach schriftlicher Anordnung vorausgesetzt. Die zu reinigenden Gesamtflächen betragen im Jahr 946.696,08m² (Oberschule an der Helgolander Straße), 901.086,96m² (Marie-Curie-Schule), 769.884,60m² (Schule Oberneuland) und 600.528,43m² (Kippenberg-Gymnasium). Objektbegehungen finden am 12.10.2026 um 10:00 Uhr (Oberschule an der Helgolander Straße), am 13.10.2026 um 10:00 Uhr (Schule Oberneuland), am 13.10.2026 um 11:30 Uhr (Marie-Curie-Schule) und am 14.10.2026 um 10:00 Uhr (Kippenberg-Gymnasium) statt. Die Begehung der Gebäude ist verpflichtend; eine Nichtteilnahme führt zum Ausschluss vom Vergabeverfahren bezogen auf das jeweilige Los. Sollten Sie also bspw. ausschließlich bei der Begehung am 12.10.2026 teilnehmen, werden Angebote für die Lose 2, 3 und 4 von der Wertung ausgeschlossen und nur das Angebot für Los 1 gewertet. Eine Anmeldung ist nur bis zum 09.10.2026 um 12:00 Uhr möglich. Bitte melden Sie sich per E-Mail an: gebaeudeservice@immobilien.bremen.de Nach der Anmeldung erhalten Sie eine Bestätigung mit weiteren Details (u.a. zum Treffpunkt). Bitte teilen Sie uns auch mit, an welchen der vier Begehungen Sie teilnehmen möchten (alle oder nur einzelne). Waschmaschinenanschlüsse sind in der Marie-Curie-Schule, der Schule Oberneuland und im Kippenberg-Gymnasium vorhanden. In der Oberschule an der Helgolander Straße gibt es keine Waschmaschinenanschlüsse. Reinigungsfenster: Nach Absprache innerhalb der zuschlagsfreien Zeiten zwischen 05:00 und 22:00 Uhr. Weitere Details zur Beschreibung der Beschaffung finden Sie in den Vergabeunterlagen in der Leistungsbeschreibung und im Leistungsverzeichnis. Die Vergabestelle behält sich vor, Angebote, deren effektiver Stundenverrechnungssatz (einschließlich aller gewährten Nachlässe) unter 180% des derzeit gültigen Tariflohnes liegt und damit unauskömmlich erscheint, vertieft zu prüfen. Angebote, deren effektiver Stundenverrechnungssatz unter 170% des derzeit gültigen Tariflohnes liegt, erscheinen automatisch unauskömmlich und werden direkt ohne weitere Prüfung ausgeschlossen. Die Vergabestelle fordert daher alle Bieter auf, den dem Angebot zugrunde liegenden Stundenverrechnungssatz gemäß dem Schema des Bundesinnungsverbandes Gebäudereinigung darzustellen und die Auskömmlichkeit des Angebots in den Einzelbestandteilen nachzuweisen. Dieses Schema ist dem Angebot beizufügen. Soweit die Zweifel an der Auskömmlichkeit im Rahmen der vertieften Prüfung nicht vollständig ausgeräumt werden können, wird das Angebot von der weiteren Wertung ausgeschlossen. Dies gilt auch dann, wenn der Bieter seiner Aufklärungspflicht nicht oder nicht in der Form nachkommt, dass rückfragefrei erkennbar und mit Nachweisen belegt wird, dass alle Kostenpositionen analog branchenüblicher Standards transparent hergeleitet wurden. Wir bitten aufgrund der Unsicherheit bezüglich des tariflichen Mindestlohns ab dem 01.01.2027 darum, den SVS weiterhin mit dem aktuellen tariflichen Mindestlohn von 15,00€ zu kalkulieren.

title: Netherlands – Technical testing, analysis and consultancy services – Informatiebeveiligingsonderzoeken (RVICTO-PT) 2026
description: Deze aanbesteding betreft het sluiten van een raamovereenkomst voor het uitvoeren van informatiebeveiligingsonderzoeken (penetratietesten). Het doel is het identificeren van digitale kwetsbaarheden in systemen, applicaties en andere objecten, teneinde deze te verhelpen of te mitigeren. De penetratietesten worden uitgevoerd via geautomatiseerde én handmatige methoden en vloeien voort uit de zorgplicht die deelnemers hebben op grond van de NIS2-richtlijn en de daarop gebaseerde Cyberbeveiligingswet. Deze raamovereenkomst is bestemd voor meerdere rijksdeelnemers, waaronder verschillende ministeries en centrale overheidsorganen. Voor de volledige lijst van deelnemers per ministerie en organisatie verwijzen wij naar paragraaf 1.1.1 van het Aanbestedingsdocument. Geraamde waarde € 20.000.000,00 maximale waarde € 35.000.000,00. Beide bedragen exclusief btw.

title: Germany – Military electronic systems – Kauf: Abwehr von weitreichenden One-Way-Effectors mit Hubschraubern (VA965)
description: Zur Überprüfung der Effektivität der Bordbewaffnung von Transport- und Kampfhubschraubern gegen weitreichende unbemannte Drohnen, vergleichbar mit SHAHED 136 wird eine Flugzieldarstellung (sechs Stück) benötigt. Die Flugzieldarstellung muss auf einem Übungsplatz der Bundeswehr in einem Flugbeschränkungsgebiet betrieben werden. Beschreibung des Testmusters: Für die Durchführung der Untersuchung werden 6 Flugzieldarstellungen gekauft, die: - eine Spannweite von mindestens 2m, maximal 3,5m haben, - in einer Flughöhe von 300 bis 2000 Fuß betrieben werden können, - eine Geschwindigkeit von 90 - 120kts Airspeed fliegen können, - eine Flugzeit von mindestens 30 Minuten erreichen und - einen Sicherheitsmechanismus haben, dass auch nach Beschuss und Beschädigung ein Verlassen der Übungsplatzgrenze ausgeschlossen ist. - Sicherheitsabbruchsystem: Die Flugzieldarstellung darf die Flugbox bei Beschädigung keinesfalls verlassen und muss unmittelbar im Rahmen der physikalisch-technischen Möglichkeiten abstürzen (Eignungsvoraussetzung). Darüber hinaus sind für die Durchführung der Untersuchung gefordert: - mindestens 6 Schießübungen, - die Auswertung von Treffern in Echtzeit oder nach Bergung und - in mindestens einem Durchgang soll die Flugzieldarstellung durch Waffenwirkung zum Absturz gebracht werden, ohne dass ein Trefferauswertesystem einen Fallschirm auslöst

title: Belgium – Repair and maintenance services – Technisch onderhoud - Elektrische hoog- en laagspanningsinstallaties DNBBA
description: Deze opdracht betreft het technisch onderhoud van hoog- en laagspanningsinstallaties binnen de DNBBA-infrastructuur van Brussels Airport. De opdracht omvat het preventief en curatief onderhoud van hoogspanningscabines, laagspanningsverdeelborden en aanverwante elektrische installaties in terminalgebouwen, andere en technische gebouwen, alsook geselecteerde buiteninstallaties, met als doel de betrouwbaarheid, beschikbaarheid en veiligheid van de elektrische infrastructuur te waarborgen. De opdracht is opgedeeld in twee percelen.

title: Breastfeeding Peer Support Service
description: The Service provided by the Provider shall deliver coordinated, accessible and effective breastfeeding peer support across Leeds, embedded within established pathways and programmes and available in both community and hospital settings. It will ensure that all families can benefit from high-quality, evidence-informed support delivered by trained volunteers, alongside the provision of a hospital-grade breast pump loan scheme that meets the needs of service users and complements existing infant feeding support. The Service will foster environments that promote, welcome and normalise breastfeeding, contributing to a citywide culture where breastfeeding is recognised as a shared community responsibility.

title: Beaverlodge Cross Connection Control Implementation Project
description: Description: The objective of this project is to ensure the potable water supply at Agriculture and Agri-Food Canada (AAFC) is safe and in compliance with applicable codes and guidelines, and municipal bylaws. This project will see the implementation of recommendations from a cross connection control evaluation completed in 2025 at the Beaverlodge Research Farm located at PO BOX 29, 100038 TOWNSHIP ROAD 720, COUNTY OF GRANDE PRAIRIE, Beaverlodge, Alberta, T0H 0C0. There are approximately 35 backflow preventers to be installed in 10 buildings. Backflow preventors include 14 reduced pressure principle assemblies, 3 atmospheric vacuum breakers, 3 air gaps, 1 duel check valve assembly, 9 hose connection vacuum breakers, 3 mixing valves and 1 pressure vacuum breaker. Plumbing rearrangements may be necessary for installation, code compliance, and for implementation of drawing and specification requirements. The site will be fully occupied throughout construction. In order to minimize disruption to operations, construction will need to take into consideration the use and occupancy of the adjacent areas and incorporate phasing and scheduling activities to suit. Water shut downs will need to be coordinated with site maintenance and research staff to ensure as little disruption to the operations as possible. The work will be conducted on AAFC property and will require trades staff to obtain a reliability status security clearance prior to being on site for the work. Basis of selection: This is a two phase selection process. Bidders responding to this ITT are to submit in two phases. Phase One qualification covers only the qualifications and experience of the Bidders. Following the evaluation of Phase One submissions, Bidders will be advised of the result of the assessment of their submission and the status of the Phase Two tender. Phase Two Bidders will be provided an Invitation to Tender (ITT) for the financial evaluation in relation to the specifications and drawings. A combination of the Phase One and Phase Two submissions constitutes the final bid. Initially, Bidders are invited to submit their qualifications in the first phase of the selection procedure. Only the Phase One information asked for in the ITT is to be included in Phase One submissions, and evaluation of Phase One submissions will be carried out only on the Phase One information requested. Construction Time: The Contractor must perform and complete the Work by March 31, 2027. SOLICITATIONS MUST BE SUBMITTED TO AAFC AT: See Section 3 of the Invitation to Qualify. Qualifications must be submitted only to the Agriculture and Agri-Food Canada (AAFC) Bid Receiving Unit by the date and time indicated on page 1 of the Invitation to Qualify. Refer to the attached solicitation documents to obtain further information. Canada retains the right to negotiate with any supplier on any procurement. Documents may be submitted in either official language of Canada. PROCURING OFFICE: Melissa Smith, Procurement Specialist Agriculture and Agri-Food Canada Western Service Centre 300 – 2010 12th Avenue Regina, SK S4P 0M3 Telephone: 306-515-4796 E-mail address: melissa.smith3@agr.gc.ca AAFC has adopted the Integrity Regime administered by Public Services and Procurement Canada. As a result, the integrity provisions are being applied in AAFC procurement activities as outlined in this solicitation. Canada will make available Notices of Proposed Procurement (NPP), bid solicitations and related documents for download through the Government Electronic Tendering Service (GETS) at https://canadabuys.canada.ca/en/solicitation-opportunities. Canada is not responsible and will not assume any liabilities whatsoever for the information found on websites of third parties. In the event an NPP, bid solicitation or related documentation would be amended, Canada will not be sending notifications. Canada will post all amendments, including significant enquiries received and their replies, using GETS. It is the sole responsibility of the Bidder to regularly consult GETS for the most up-to-date information. Canada will not be liable for any oversight on the Bidder's part nor for notification services offered by a third party. Having a business profile in the IBD will increase your company’s visibility and may provide additional business. A profile in the IBD can also allow you to compete for federal government contracts that are set-aside for Indigenous businesses through the Procurement Strategy for Indigenous Businesses. For more information and to review eligibility criteria and register, visit: www.canada.ca/indigenousbusinessdirectory.

title: Errichtung einer Grundwassermessstelle zur Untersuchung eines tiefer liegenden Grundwasserleiters, SAD Laucha
description: Neubau einer Grundwassermessstelle in folgendem Umfang: - Vorbereitungsarbeiten, Sicherungsmaßnahmen, Dokumentation von Ausgangs- und Endzustand; - Beseitigung der hinderlichen Vegetation (Mäharbeiten, Baumfällung bzw. -rückschnitt); - Herrichten, Befestigen und Unterhalten der Flächen für den Bohrplatz und für die Baustelleneinrichtung (ca. 500 m²); - Einrichten einer mobilen Trinkwasser- und Stromversorgung; - Durchführung von Arbeitsschutzmaßnahmen, Schwarz-Weiß-Anlage; - Bohrarbeiten und Bau von einer Grundwassermessstelle im tieferen Grundwasserleiter, angenommene Bohrendteufe maximal 80 m: # ca. 13 m Bohren im Lockergestein, Mindestdurchmesser 300 mm; # max. 67 m Bohren im Festgestein als Kernbohrung ≥ 100 mm Durchmesser; # Aufweiten der Kernbohrung auf Enddurchmesser ≥ 300 mm; # Liefern von Kernkisten und Auslegen der Bohrkerne; # Einrichten und Betrieb eine Kernlagers; # bohrlochgeophysikalische Messungen zur Bestimmung der Wasserzutritte im Festgestein; # Ausbau zur GWM mit Rohrmaterial PVC-U DN 125, Festlegung der Schlitzweite der Filterrohre nach Bohrergebnis, inkl. Zentrierungen; # Verfüllen des Ringraums mit Filtersand/Filterkies und Abdichten mit Tonpellets (magnetisch markiert) oder Zement-Bentonit-Suspension; # Entsanden/Klarpumpen als Kurzpumpversuch (max. 2 Stunden); # bohrlochgeophysikalische Messungen zur Ausbaukontrolle; # Herstellen eines Abschlussbauwerks über Flur. - Containergestellung, Sammeln und Entsorgen aller anfallenden Medien (Bohrgut/Bohrschlamm, Bohrkerne, Bohrspülung, Klarpumpwasser); - Einmessen der Neubaumessstelle im Landessystem; - Übergabe einer Dokumentation zum Messstellenbau; - Grünschnitt entsorgen oder häckseln und verteilen; - Räumen der Baustelle, Rückbau der BE-Fläche.

title: Delivery of Meteorological Weather Balloons to Danish Meteorological Institute (DMI)
description: The scope of this tender is to procure a framework agreement, which enables DMI to purchase meteorological weather balloons over a four-year period. This agreement will enable DMI to conduct and collect upper-air meteorological measurements that provide inputs to numerical weather predictions and additionally are used for other purposes consistent with DMI’s general work scope and obligations as National Meteorological Service and contributor to international collaboration. The weather balloons will be used for radiosonde measurements which will be conducted from DMI’s manually operated radiosonde stations (four in Greenland and three established onboard ships sailing between Denmark and Greenland). The deliveries will consist of meteorological weather balloons with necks.

Germany – Agricultural, forestry, horticultural, aquacultural and apicultural services – Vermeidungs-, Minderungs-, Schutz- sowie vorgezogene Ausgleichsmaßnahmen (CEF-Maßnahmen) in den Gewerken Landschaftsbau und Artenschutz
description: Die 50Hertz Transmission GmbH betreibt das Höchstspannungsnetz im Norden und Osten Deutschlands und verantwortet dessen bedarfsgerechten Ausbau zur Umsetzung der Energiewende. Im Rahmen dieser Aufgabe werden Freileitungs-, Erdkabel-, Offshore-Anbindungs- und Umspannwerksprojekte geplant, genehmigt und umgesetzt. Für die Genehmigung und Realisierung dieser Vorhaben sind regelmäßig naturschutzfachliche Maßnahmen erforderlich. Diese umfassen insbesondere Vermeidungs-, Minderungs-, Schutz- sowie vorgezogene Ausgleichsmaßnahmen (CEF-Maßnahmen). Die Maßnahmen dienen der Vermeidung artenschutzrechtlicher Verbotstatbestände, der Sicherung der ökologischen Funktion betroffener Lebensstätten sowie der rechtssicheren Umsetzung der Vorhaben. Die Maßnahmen ergeben sich insbesondere aus landschaftspflegerischen Begleitplänen, artenschutzrechtlichen Fachbeiträgen, Genehmigungsunterlagen, behördlichen Nebenbestimmungen sowie Festsetzungen in Planfeststellungs- und Plangenehmigungsverfahren. Sie werden teilweise bereits vor Baubeginn erforderlich und können die Bau- und Betriebsphase begleiten. Ziel dieser Ausschreibung ist der Abschluss von Rahmenverträgen mit verschiedenen Auftragnehmer pro Los zur Erbringung landschaftsbaulicher und artenschutzfachlicher Leistungen im Zusammenhang mit naturschutzfachlich begründeten CEF-, Minderungs-, Vermeidungs- und Schutzmaßnahmen. Neben der 50Hertz Transmission GmbH sind alle mit der Elia Gruppe verbundenen Unternehmen (insbesondere 50Hertz Offshore GmbH, 50Hertz Connectors GmbH, Elia Grid International GmbH, Elia Transmission Belgium S.A., Elia Asset S.A. und Elia Engineering S.A.) berechtigt, diesen Vertrag in Anspruch zu nehmen. Darüber hinaus behält sich der Auftraggeber vor, diesen Vertrag auf aktuelle oder künftige verbundene Unternehmen oder Unternehmen, an den der Auftraggeber beteiligt ist, zu übertragen. Gleichermaßen bleibt dem Auftraggeber bei einer gesellschaftsrechtlichen Umstrukturierung des Auftragnehmers oder bei Wegfall einzelner Mitglieder eines Unternehmensverbunds (ARGE als AN) vorbehalten, den Vertrag auf den neuen Unternehmensträger oder verbleibende Mitglieder eines Unternehmensverbundes zu übertragen.

title: Norway – Canteen management services – Purchase of canteen services
description: The assignment shall be carried out in BIR ́s administration building at Lungegårdskaien 42. The canteen was first used in March 2023. The canteen is equipped with necessary kitchen machines, fixtures and detachments. Electricity, public fees, internet, cutlery, porcelain, new kitchen machines/detachments as well as daily cleaning of customer areas will be taken care of and costly by BIR AS. The canteen can cover a day need of approx. 80 employees + any guests that are on the building. The number of visitors to the canteen is subject to varying. It is estimated that there will be an average of approx. 35-40 users/visitors per workday. (See annex 4 for further information on visits per week in the canteen in the period from 1 January 2026 to 19 April 2026). This is mainly justified by the home office scheme for BIR ́s employees. As regards the later requirements and price set up, the Tenderer shall use 35 users on average per workday (Monday - Friday).

NOTICE FOR FILING AGENCY PROTESTS United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) Ombudsman Program The United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) is committed to fair, transparent, and efficient acquisitions. Interested parties with concerns about this solicitation are encouraged to seek resolution through the following USDA procedures. Tier 1: Contracting Officer Concern Resolution Submission: Interested parties with concerns about either the solicitation or subsequent award should first submit their concern directly to the Contracting Officer, providing sufficient detail to allow the Contracting Officer to understand and assess the issue. Process: The Contracting Officer will review the concern, seek clarification as needed, and engage with the interested party to attempt prompt resolution. Review Timeline: The Contracting Officer will make every effort to provide a response or resolution within 10 business days of receiving the concern. Effect on Award or Performance: Tier 1 engagement is not considered an official notification of filing an agency protest and does not pause solicitation deadlines, delay award decisions, or suspend contract performance. Next Steps: If the matter cannot be resolved at Tier 1, the interested party may file a written agency protest under Tier 2. USDA encourages all parties to seek resolution with the Contracting Officer before filing an agency protest. Tier 2: Agency Protest If concerns cannot be resolved at Tier 1, an interested party may file a written agency protest with either the Contracting Officer or the USDA Independent Review Authority. The decision by the USDA Independent Review Authority is an alternative to a decision by the Contracting Officer. The USDA Independent Review Authority will not consider an appeal of the Contracting Officer�s decision on an agency protest. The protest must state whether the protester elects review by the Contracting Officer, by the USDA Independent Review Authority. If no election is stated, the Contracting Officer will decide the protest. Required Information: Protests shall include the information set forth in FAR 33.104-4 (a)(3). Failure to submit the required information may result in a delay or dismissal of the protest. Submission: Agency protests should be submitted electronically to SPE.inquiry@usda.gov and the Contracting Officer. Timeliness: Protests must be filed within the timeframes specified in FAR 33.104. Effect on Award or Performance: Contract awards or performance will be suspended during the protest period unless justified in writing for urgent and compelling reasons or determined to be in the best interest of the Government. Review Timeline: USDA strives to resolve agency-level protests within 35 business days of receipt. Election of Forum: By filing a protest with USDA, the protesters agree not to file a protest on the same matter with the Government Accountability Office (GAO) or any other external forum while the agency protest is pending. If such a protest is filed externally, the USDA agency protest will be dismissed. Questions: Questions regarding this notice or protest procedures should be directed to the Contracting Officer identified in this solicitation.

title: Bulk Hard Red Winter Wheat and Sorghum for use in International Food Assistance Programs
description: This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial products or commercial services prepared in accordance with part 5.101(d). This announcement constitutes the only solicitation. Offers are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. Solicitation number 12-1NMG-27-B-0001 is issued as a International Commodity invitation for bid (IFB) for Bulk Hard Red Winter Wheat and Sorghum. This acquisition is not set-aside for small business concerns. This solicitation incorporates provisions and clauses by reference. The full text of provisions and clauses may be accessed electronically at www.acquisition.gov. NOTICE FOR FILING AGENCY PROTESTS United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) Ombudsman Program The United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) is committed to fair, transparent, and efficient acquisitions. Interested parties with concerns about this solicitation are encouraged to seek resolution through the following USDA procedures. Tier 1: Contracting Officer Concern Resolution Submission: Interested parties with concerns about either the solicitation or subsequent award should first submit their concern directly to the Contracting Officer, providing sufficient detail to allow the Contracting Officer to understand and assess the issue. Process: The Contracting Officer will review the concern, seek clarification as needed, and engage with the interested party to attempt prompt resolution. Review Timeline: The Contracting Officer will make every effort to provide a response or resolution within 10 business days of receiving the concern. Effect on Award or Performance: Tier 1 engagement is not considered an official notification of filing an agency protest and does not pause solicitation deadlines, delay award decisions, or suspend contract performance. Next Steps: If the matter cannot be resolved at Tier 1, the interested party may file a written agency protest under Tier 2. USDA encourages all parties to seek resolution with the Contracting Officer before filing an agency protest. Tier 2: Agency Protest If concerns cannot be resolved at Tier 1, an interested party may file a written agency protest with either the Contracting Officer or the USDA Independent Review Authority. The decision by the USDA Independent Review Authority is an alternative to a decision by the Contracting Officer. The USDA Independent Review Authority will not consider an appeal of the Contracting Officer�s decision on an agency protest. The protest must state whether the protester elects review by the Contracting Officer, by the USDA Independent Review Authority. If no election is stated, the Contracting Officer will decide the protest. Required Information: Protests shall include the information set forth in FAR 33.104-4 (a)(3). Failure to submit the required information may result in a delay or dismissal of the protest. Submission: Agency protests should be submitted electronically to SPE.inquiry@usda.gov and the Contracting Officer. Timeliness: Protests must be filed within the timeframes specified in FAR 33.104. Effect on Award or Performance: Contract awards or performance will be suspended during the protest period unless justified in writing for urgent and compelling reasons or determined to be in the best interest of the Government. Review Timeline: USDA strives to resolve agency-level protests within 35 business days of receipt. Election of Forum: By filing a protest with USDA, the protesters agree not to file a protest on the same matter with the Government Accountability Office (GAO) or any other external forum while the agency protest is pending. If such a protest is filed externally, the USDA agency protest will be dismissed. Questions: Questions regarding this notice or protest procedures should be directed to the Contracting Officer identified in this solicitation.

title: Y1DA--REPLACE ROOFS AND REPAIR FACADES BUILDING 6 AND 7 AT THE NORTHPORT VA MEDICAL CENTER PROJECT NUMBER: 632-23-112
description: ****** THIS IS A PRE-SOLICITATION NOTICE ONLY ****** This is a public synopsis of a forthcoming solicitation in accordance with FAR 36.213-2. This is NOT a solicitation, and no solicitation documents are currently publicly available. This pre-solicitation notice is for Solicitation Number 36C24226B0059, Project Number 632-23-112, for the Replace Roofs and Repair Facades Buildings 6 and 7 at the Northport VA Medical Center located on 79 Middleville Road, Northport, NY 11768. This project will be 100% Service-Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business Set-Aside (SDVOSB). Competition for this procurement is restricted to verified SERVICE-DISABLED VETERAN OWNED SMALL BUSINESS (SDVOSB) Contractors. The SDVOSB must be a small business under the relevant NAICS code and must be registered and verified in SBA's Small Business Search (https://search.certifications.sba.gov/) and https://www.sam.gov. The NAICS code for this procurement is 236220, Commercial and Institutional Building Construction, size standard: $45 million. IAW VAAR 852.219-10, the VIP-listed SDVOSB. Prospective Contractor will not pay more than 85% of the amount paid by the government to the prime for contract performance, excluding the cost of materials, to firms that are not VIP-listed SDVOSBs. The magnitude of construction for this project is between $5,000,000 and $10,000,000. SCOPE OF WORK: The Scope of Work shall generally consist of, but not limited to the following: The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), NCO 2, Northport VA Medical Center, is seeking highly qualified construction firms to perform full roof replacement and repair of historical brick and stone facades at Building 6 and Building 7. Building 6 is fully occupied, and work will be phased in four stages to limit impact to one side of the building at a time. Building 7 is mostly vacant except for the basement level, and work can be completed in a single phase while maintaining protected exit access from the basement. The project includes complete roof replacement at both buildings, including flashing, fascia boards and trim, soffits, drip edges, underlayment, and shingles, along with replacement of deteriorated roof sheathing where required. Facade work includes repair of distressed brick masonry (cracking, spalling, bowing, and mortar deterioration), repointing to match existing mortar, replacement of damaged cast stone water table sections and windowsills, and stripping, cleaning, and refinishing or replacing window lintel support angles. Additional work includes reconstruction of the main entrance stair and support walls at Building 7, replacement of storm drainage and site drainage systems including new yard drains, catch basins, and underground piping with associated regrading and landscape restoration, and abatement of asbestos-containing materials as indicated on the drawings. PROJECT COMPLETION: Contractor to start immediately after receiving the Notice to Proceed and complete required work in 400 calendar days. Prospective contractors must be registered at https://www.sam.gov in accordance with 38 CFR Part 74 and VAAR 819.70 to be eligible for award. There will be a site visit held for this project and all prospective bidders are strongly encouraged to attend. Details of the site visit will be included in the solicitation document. It is anticipated that the solicitation will be issued on/about September 25, 2026. Information for Bid details, Specifications, Drawings and Contract Forms will be available in electronic format only at: https://www.sam.gov. All interested parties (subs & primes) should register for a user account which lets you save searches, follow changes to opportunities, and join interested vendor lists, and verified as a SDVOSB in SBA's Small Business Search (https://search.certifications.sba.gov/) at the time of offer submission and before award of this procurement. title: Collection of surface water samples and ancillary data for the Canadian Water Monitoring Program for Pesticides in priority Ontario watersheds.
description: Health Canada (HC) evaluates the risks to human health and the environment associated with the use of pesticides and regulates pesticide products in Canada under the Pest Control Products Act. In the interest of increasing the availability of real-world data for use in pesticide risk assessments, HC coordinates the Canadian Water Monitoring Program for Pesticides (CWMPP). As part of this program, water samples are analysed to determine the concentrations of pesticides present in Canadian waters. Federal laboratories will analyse approximately 200 chemicals (i.e., pesticide active ingredients and transformation products) in water from various regions across Canada. Ancillary data and expert advice assist in improving our collective understanding of any patterns observed or any potential levels of concern. October 26, 2026: Added Q&As.

title: Purchase of eleven (11) Electrometer/High-Resistance Meters and Accessories (Keithley 6517B or Equivalent)
description: The National Research Council Canada (NRC) requires to purchase eleven (11) Electrometer/High-Resistance Meters and Accessories (Keithley 6517B, or equivalent). The equipment is used continuously in applications where low-current and high-resistance measurements require exceptional signal-to-noise performance, stability, leakage control, guarding, triaxial connectivity, and measurement repeatability. METRO operates under a rigorous quality system and maintains measurement standards that must be demonstrably traceable, reliable, and internationally recognized. The existing Keithley-based measurement platform has been fully integrated into validated measurement systems, software applications, automation scripts, operating procedures, and technical documentation. Maintaining the same instrument platform supports compatibility with internationally accepted metrology practices and helps ensure continuity and comparability of measurement results used to support national measurement standards and regulatory obligations. The use of an equivalent manufacturer's instrument would require extensive technical evaluation and verification before it could be incorporated into operational measurement systems. This work would include performance testing, comparison studies, revalidation of measurement methods, review and potential revisions, updates to quality-system documentation, modifications to software drivers and automation scripts, and assessment of impacts on established laboratory procedures. In addition, evaluation of a competing instrument would likely require acquisition of a demonstration unit and could result in disruptions to ongoing operations, delays to standards-maintenance activities, and potential interruptions to services provided to clients.

title: ACAN-NRCan Nuvis Techonologies Inc. Support
description: The Petawawa Research Forest (PRF) is a 10,000-hectare (ha) research forest located in Chalk River, Ontario. The land, which the PRF is on, is owned by the Canadian Department of National Defence (DND), Garrison Petawawa, however, under a joint memorandum of understanding (MOU) the PRF is staffed and operated by Natural Resources Canada (NRCan). Under this MOU, NRCan is responsible for wildfire detection for the entire property, approximately 30,000 ha’s. To date, fire detection on the property has been conducted using two fire towers with cupola’s (27.5 and 38.5 metres tall) staffed with personnel who visually detect fires/smoke and biangulate the location. In 2018, the 38.5-METRE-TALL tower was decommissioned limiting our ability to detect fire on the property. There is also a radio tower located on PRF property. This tower, referred to as the “Radio Tower”, has not been used for fire detection in the past. However, this tower has electrical power, which supplies power to the radio repeater that is currently on the Radio Tower. The Radio Tower can have more than one piece of equipment attached to its structure (i.e. the radio repeater will remain on the Radio Tower) and is a suitable location for a fire detection camera. NRCan was able to replace the existing fire detection system in 2022 by way of installing two optical camera sensor systems with fire detection monitoring software by Nuvis Technologies Inc. The objective of this requirement is to renew hardware and software support for the existing wildfire camera detection system. The work will involve the following: Support for Wildfire Guardian Software: 1. Support and maintenance of the existing software environment 2. Diagnostics and troubleshooting of bugs or software issues 3. Administrator support 4. Software upgrades as they are available Hardware Support for all equipment: 1. annual preventative maintenance; 2. seasonal startup and shutdown; and 3. corrective maintenance labour.

title: Z1DA--NRM CONST - 528A7-18-707 - Replace Boiler Stack Rome CBOC
description: This pre-solicitation notice is to inform potential offerors that the Rome Community Based Outpatient Center (CBOC) in Rome, NY will be posting a solicitation (36C24227R0008) on or about October 30th, 2026, to provide all labor, materials, tools, equipment, and supervision necessary to complete the Replace Boiler Stack Rome CBOC project (528A7-18-707). This project is necessary to demolish two (2) existing boiler exhaust stacks and one (1) generator steam relief stack, the concrete / masonry chimney structure and seal the existing roof. The construction and installation of two (2) new steel boiler exhaust stacks, the steel support structure, and one (1) steel generator exhaust pipe at the Rome CBOC, 125 Brookley Road, Rome, NY 13441. It has been determined that there are qualified firms that can perform under NAICS Code 238220, "Plumbing, Heating, and Air Conditioning Contractors with a size standard of $19M. This procurement is 100% set-aside for small businesses. The estimated construction value of this project is between $500,000 and $1,000,000. Information regarding the scheduled site visit will be stated in the Solicitation. Bid bonding will be required to respond to this RFP once released. OBTAINING SOLICITATION MATERIAL Solicitation materials consisting of the Information for Proposal Details, Specifications, Drawings and Contract Forms will be available on http://www.sam.gov in electronic format only. These should be available on or about October 30th, 2026. An Offeror's mailing list, list of interested parties and/or list of attendees at site visits WILL NOT be prepared nor distributed by the Contract Specialist. SOLICITATION AMENDMENTS: Amendments to the solicitation will be posted at http://www.sam.gov. Paper copies of the amendments will NOT be individually mailed. No other notification of amendments will be provided. Offerors are reminded that they are responsible for obtaining and acknowledging all amendments to this solicitation and attaching to their proposal. All proposals and correspondence will be by email only to the Contract Specialist: Ryan.Seburn@va.gov.

title: S218--Snow Removal Services Wilmington VAMC
description: This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial services prepared in accordance with the format in RFO Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) subpart 12. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation; quotes are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. This solicitation is issued as an RFQ, number 36C24427Q0012 for snow removal services at the Wilmington VAMC. The solicitation incorporates provisions and clauses by reference. The full text of provisions and clauses may be accessed electronically at www.acquisition.gov. This Solicitation is set-aside for Service-Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business concerns. title: J042--Fire Alarm System Monitoring and Programming INTENT TO SOLE SOURCE
description: Under Statutory Authority 41 U.S.C. § 1901 the VA Great Lakes Acquisition Center (GLAC) intends to negotiate a sole source contract with Johnson Controls Fire Protection. The contractor shall furnish all labor, material, tools, equipment, supervision, transportation, and expertise to perform Fire/smoke alarm testing and fire suppression systems in accordance with all current regulations to perform service to all fire alarm devices and equipment located at the Captain James A. Lovell Federal Health Care Center. This acquisition is conducted under the authority of 41 U.S.C. § 1901 Simplified acquisition procedures as implemented in RFO 12.102 only one responsible source and no other supplies or services will satisfy agency requirements. This will be a firm fixed price contract for a base plus (4) four option year contract. The NAICS Code is 561621. This Notice of Intent is not a request for competitive quotes. No solicitation documents are available and telephone requests will not be honored. However, if a firm believes it can meet the requirements it must furnish information about its products and services, as well as references from other customers who are using these products and services to the Contracting Officer by 9:00AM LOCAL TIME 10/28/2026. Supporting evidence must be furnished in sufficient detail to demonstrate the ability to comply with the above requirements. Responses received will be evaluated. However, a determination by the Government not to compete the proposed procurement based upon responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. If no responses are received, the Contracting Officer will proceed with the sole source negotiation with the Johnson Controls Fire Protection. Capability statements shall be submitted by email only as a MS Word or Adobe PDF attachment to Lori Eastmead at Lori Eastmead@va.gov. TELEPHONIC INQUIRIES WILL NOT BE ACCEPTED. STATEMENT OF WORK (SOW) Fire Alarm System Monitoring/ Programming 1. GENERAL Captain James A. Lovell Federal Health Care Center (FHCC), located at 3001 Green Bay Road, North Chicago, IL 60064 requires 24/7 365 Monitoring of Fire alarm and suppression systems. Including, tech labor for programming with monthly visits twice per month. 2. SCOPE The contractor shall furnish all labor, material, tools, equipment, supervision, transportation, and expertise to perform Fire/smoke alarm testing and fire suppression systems in accordance with all current National Fire Protection Agency (NFPA) / The Joint Commission regulations and perform service to all fire alarm devices and equipment to include all devices located at the Captain James A. Lovell Federal Health Care Center. Contractor shall provide service personnel which are certified on a Simplex Grinnell system to include access to proprietary programing to perform service to all Station Fire Systems. 3. PERIOD OF PERFORMANCE The anticipated period of performance, (POP) will include a one (1) year base period, plus four (4) one-year option periods; that are to be exercised at the Government s discretion. 4. CONFORMANCE STANDARDS Contractors shall ensure that the equipment functions in conformance with The Joint Commission Elements of Performance EC.02.03.05, the latest published edition of National Fire Protection Association (NFPA) Codes, Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA), Veterans Administration (VA) standards, International Organization of Standard (ISO) 9000, and manufacturer/industry standards. Must comply with records management guidelines outlined in the following web link https://www.archives.gov/records-mgmt/policy/records-mgmt-language . 5. QUALIFICATIONS Contractor shall provide qualified technicians that shall have at minimum National Institute for Certification in Engineering Technologies (NICET) level II or higher. Contractor shall provide service and monitoring of all fire alarm systems and fire suppression systems on station. The monitoring Contractor must be listed for central station service (UL 827 or FM-approved) and issue a Certificate of Alarm Service to the protected premises. 6. SERVICES TO BE PROVIDED Contractors must provide 24 hours per day, seven (7) days per week monitoring with designated fire department notification upon all alarms. Covers Tech Labor during normal working hours. Contractor shall provide 2 technician scheduled visits a month at facility to provide ongoing service. These visits shall be scheduled to occur on the 2nd Thursday of the month and the last Thursday of the month. This is to ensure even number of visits are spread out to maximize effectiveness. 7. HOURS OF SERVICES A schedule of Technician visits shall be established to be completed during the working hours, Monday through Friday, 7:00 AM Local Time until 3:30 PM Local Local Time to the extent possible. National and Federal Holidays shall be exempt. The service schedule shall be confirmed between the Contractor and Contracting Officer Representative (COR) prior to the first working day of the month. National and Federal Holidays that shall be exempt: New Years' Day Labor Day Martin Luther King, Jr Birthday Columbus Day President s Day Veterans Day Memorial Day Thanksgiving Day Juneteenth Day Christmas Day Independence Day Any other day specifically declared by the President of the United States to be a National or Federal Holiday. When a holiday falls on a Sunday, the following Monday shall be observed as a National or Federal Holiday by U.S. Government agencies. When a holiday falls on a Saturday, the preceding Friday shall be observed as a National or Federal Holiday. 8. DOCUMENTATION The contractor shall provide documentation records upon request in regard to monitoring. Contractor shall provide documentation after every visit to the COR to properly document repairs and history for recordkeeping and Joint commission requirements. 9. PERFORMANCE MONITORING COR shall monitor all documentation to ensure compliance with all regulations and proposals. Any regulation changes or requirements shall be provided to Contractor via email by Contracting Officer Representative or their designee. 10. SECURITY REQUIREMENTS Test and maintenance personnel shall be required to obtain FHCC issued Contractor Identification badges from Building 135 PIV Office. Contractor shall be responsible for keeping the credentials renewed as required. The identification shall be always worn visible while on FHCC property. 11. CHECK-IN/CHECK-OUT The contractor shall check-in with Captain James A. Lovell Federal Health Care Center Controls personnel in Building 188. Contractor shall check-out with Captain James A. Lovell Federal Health Care Center Controls personnel in Building 188 upon completion of services or at the duration of the day, whichever shall be completed first. 12. GOVERNMENT-FURNISHED EQUIPMENT (GFE)/GOVERNMENT-FURNISHED INFORMATION (GFI) No GFE or GFI will be furnished. 13. Key Personnel The contractor shall provide a contract manager who shall be responsible for the performance of work. The name of the designated manager and an alternate who shall act for the contractor when the manager is absent shall be designated in writing to the contracting officer. The contract manager shall have full authority relating to the daily operation of this contract. The contract manager shall be available between 7:00am and 3:30pm Local Time Monday through Friday except for Federal holidays. 14.
